Police arrested him shortly after the incident, seizing a licensed weapon believed to be used in the shooting. Four of the victims were from the same family, highlighting the tragedy of the situation.

title: Fake seizures, attack on prison guards: How 17 inmates escaped TN jail at midnight
content: Seventeen undertrial inmates managed to escape from Thekkampatti sub-jail in Tamil Nadu's Theni district. They faked epileptic seizures to lure prison personnel into opening their cell. Once the guards entered, the inmates attacked them and fled the facility. Four of the escapees have been apprehended while thirteen remain at large despite extensive police efforts. Investigations into the jailbreak and security lapses at the jail are currently ongoing.

title: Son of AAP sarpanch shot dead outside gurdwara in Amritsar
content: Teerath Singh was shot dead outside a gurdwara in Cheete Kalan village while his friend sustained injuries. Both men were returning from paying respects at the gurdwara when the suspected assailants opened fire. Preliminary investigations indicate the murder was connected to an old land dispute rather than political rivalry. Police have identified four suspects and filed an FIR, but no arrests have been made yet.

The trek presented a series of trials, from altitude adjustments to unpredictable weather, ultimately showcasing how retirement can spark thrilling new experiences and journeys.

The court recognized the importance of this new testimony for her defense against cruelty accusations, mandating that the family court proceed with the hearing under the high court's direction.

title: Atlantic dye test shows 140 times more mixing within surface than across base
content: In a recent experiment near Martha’s Vineyard, scientists introduced rhodamine dye into the Atlantic Ocean to study its behavior. The dye spread quickly in the surface waters but demonstrated a slower descent into deeper layers. Findings showed a marked difference in mixing rates, emphasizing the complexities of ocean stratification on substance movement. This research is vital for the advancement of nutrient and pollutant transport models.

title: Court revives homeowner's lawsuit over delayed second dwelling approval

Shi asserts that the city violated state law’s requirements for prompt reviews. Thanks to a favorable ruling from an appeals court, his lawsuit is back on track, seeking over $1 million in damages for these holdups.

title: Microsoft extends buyouts to 60,000 staff in India, US, UK and Canada

Open up to level 70, the offer has no age, tenure or performance criteria and mirrors standard severance. Employees have until early December to decide. The move follows 4,800 Microsoft layoffs in July.

title: Lawrence Bishnoi shifted to high-security Ahmedabad jail block housing 2008 blasts convicts
content: a specialised high-security block at Ahmedabad’s Sabarmati Central Jail has four segregated sections of 50 prisoners each . the size of his cell is roughly 7.5x11 ft . investigators have reported zero direct calls or communication originating from Lawrence Bishnoi .

title: Saudi defence pact countries push for peace in Iran
content: the talks were the first high-level contact between Iran and the three nations since a war that began with US and Israeli strikes on Iran also spread to Saudi Arabia and Yemen . the visit was intended to open negotiating channels to “prevent the return of military escalation”

title: More violence in Arunachal as anti-dam protests spread
content: a 12-hour bandh against a proposed hydropower project in the upper subansiri district turned violent . mobs damaging vehicles and NHPC equipment and two security personnel . the latest flashpoint was daporijo town, 220km west of Pasighat by road . police conducted a flag march and appealed for peace .

title: 7 civilians killed in Jordan strike on Syrian militants in retaliation to church attack
content: seven people were killed in strikes across the southern provinces of Daraa and Sweida . five members of a family, including three children and a woman, died when a strike hit a tent . two elderly men, aged 80 and 60, were killed, the agency said .

title: Trump critic and former FBI chief Comey faces third federal case
content: comey responded to the charges in a video posted on Substack on Monday . he has not been indicted in the third federal case against him . his defence lawyers filed a motion to dismiss the charges 10 days earlier .

title: Guwahati shooting: Four of same family killed in hotel firing; accused arrested
content: police nabbed the alleged killer, Ghanakanta Gogoi and seized a licensed .32 bore pistol . the incident occurred at the hotel owned by the family in guwahati . police have not yet revealed the identities of the dead .

title: Saudi Arabia offered Houthis $1 billion through Iran to stop attacks: Report
content: reportedly offered $1 billion to Yemen's Houthi group . proposed arrangement involved transferring $1b to the group through Iran . talks reportedly brought together intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin and pakistani army chief asim Munir .

title: 'For $250, he broke up my punchline': Trump mocks heckler, alleges Soros link - video
content: a protester who interrupted president Donald Trump's rally in corinth, Mississippi, was met with chants of "USA! USA!" from the crowd . "Go home, go home... for $250, he broke up my punchline, and it was a beauty," he said . the president also alleged that such interruptions were part of a paid protest campaign .
